plan.design: Score all 904 candidate lines with the Ridge model (rank_candidates, E1). Then query the E3 evidence oracle for a stratified sample: the top 12 model-ranked lines plus 8 controls (4 mid-rank and 4 low-rank). Compute (a) Spearman correlation between E1 predictions and E3 measurements on the sampled lines and (b) the fraction of top-model-ranked lines whose measured GRWT100 is above the sample-derived high-quartile threshold. If the enrichment hypothesis holds, select the final top-10 from the highest measured lines among the top-model candidates, filling any UNOBSERVABLE slots by model rank.
controls: 4 mid-rank and 4 low-rank model candidates used as negative controls
sampled within one model call and one phenotyping regime.
plan.observation_metric: Spearman rank correlation between E1 predicted and E3 measured GRWT100 on the sampled lines (target > 0.30); and measured high-quartile hit rate among the top-model-ranked sampled lines (target > 0.50, i.e. better than chance)
plan.refutation_condition: Spearman <= 0.0 on the sampled lines, OR the top-model-ranked lines fail to show higher measured GRWT100 than low-rank controls (top-model hit rate <= 0.25).

revision: H1 supported and retained: the Ridge model's top predictions are strongly enriched for high measured GRWT100. Selection rule: pick the 10 highest-measured lines among the phenotyped top-12 model-ranked candidates, ordered by measured GRWT100 (ties broken by model rank). Remaining unmeasured candidates keep model rank as E1-only priority.
reason: All 20 oracle measurements were observable. Top-12 model-ranked lines measured 3.1-5.0 g (mean 3.72) vs 1.2-2.7 g (mean 2.00) for mid/low controls; sampled Spearman rho=0.93. Refutation condition (rho<=0 or top hit rate<=0.25) was not met.
